stories.title: Sobhita Dhulipala receives ‘Rule Breaker’ award
stories.summary: Actor Sobhita Dhulipala was honoured with the Rule Breaker award at Vogue Forces of Fashion 2026. The event celebrated her experimental choices and willingness to challenge conventional style expectations. She accepted the recognition in a sheer chiffon dress by designer Gabriella Demetriades. Rules are apparently now subject to awards.

stories.title: Vogue India hosts Forces of Fashion 2026
stories.summary: Vogue Forces of Fashion 2026 brought together industry figures at Snowball Studios in Mumbai. The event featured an exhibition of over 25 designers, a panel discussion on India’s global influence, and an awards ceremony. The gathering aimed to highlight Indian craftsmanship and material experimentation for the industry.

stories.title: Time magazine releases 100 Next India list
stories.summary: Time magazine has compiled its inaugural 100 Next India list, featuring various figures from the fashion industry. Designer Masaba Gupta was highlighted for her role in democratising luxury and influencing a generation to view the sari as more than occasion wear. The list aims to identify emerging talent.

stories.title: Prince and Princess of Wales visit Mumbai craft school
stories.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales visited the Chanakya School of Craft in Mumbai to observe collaborations in sustainable fashion and textiles. The visit highlighted the Living Museum and a multi-year initiative by the British Council and the University of the Arts London. Tradition is being researched.

stories.title: New brands shift focus of Indian luxury
stories.summary: A new generation of founders is building brands in India by blending heritage with innovation. The industry is moving away from logos and price tags to focus on craftsmanship, wellbeing, and personal connection. Modern luxury is being redefined to include active living and conscious consumerism as core values.

stories.title: Kavya Maran’s wedding wardrobe features variety
stories.summary: Sunrisers Hyderabad co-owner Kavya Maran wore multiple outfits during her wedding celebrations, including a pastel Tarun Tahiliani lehenga and various sequined gowns. The ensembles featured corsets, feathers, and embellishments. The wedding served as a showcase for bridal fashion trends and inspiration for those planning future ceremonies.

stories.title: Harris Reed discusses demi-couture in India
stories.summary: Designer Harris Reed spoke at the fourth edition of Harper’s Bazaar India LuXperiences about his vision for demi-couture and made-to-measure design. He cited India’s legacy of craftsmanship and storytelling as primary inspirations for his work. The event was presented by Emporio Armani and co-sponsored by American Express.

stories.title: Vespa wants to be part of your wardrobe and home too: Inside its first India pop-up store - Firstpost
Galeries Lafayette Mumbai marks first anniversary
stories.summary: Galeries Lafayette Mumbai has celebrated its first anniversary in partnership with Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Limited. The department store features over 250 brands and aims to provide experiential luxury in the Indian retail market. The French retailer has spent one year establishing its presence in Mumbai.

stories.title: Hayley Atwell brings Much Ado About Nothing to Broadway
stories.summary: Following a successful West End run, Jamie Lloyd’s production of Much Ado About Nothing has opened at the Winter Garden Theatre. Starring Hayley Atwell and Tom Hiddleston, the play features modern twists on the 400-year-old drama. The production is being marketed as a party for Broadway audiences.

stories.title: Governors Awards highlight menswear experimentation
stories.summary: The 2026 Governors Awards featured a mix of traditional tuxedos and experimental tailoring. Attendees including Charles Melton and Stephan James opted for asymmetrical silhouettes and wrap-style jackets from Public School New York. The event served as a venue for discussing shifts in red carpet proportions and colour.

stories.title: How to wear velvet to just like Eddie Redmayne - South China Morning Post
Gucci announces Shanghai runway show
stories.summary: Gucci has scheduled its Cruise 2028 runway presentation for May 17 in Shanghai. The announcement follows other industry activity, including a new sociopolitical exhibition at The Museum at FIT and a collaborative collection between adidas Originals and BEAMS. Trends continue to move across global fashion capitals.

stories.title: Melania Trump attends series premiere in New York
stories.summary: First Lady Melania Trump attended the premiere of Melania: The Series at Alice B. Tully Hall in New York. She appeared in a black lace Dolce and Gabbana dress. The event occurred shortly after President Trump’s recent diplomatic trip to China and Russia. The carpet was black.

stories.title: Percy Jackson premiere fashion references mythology
stories.summary: The cast of the Percy Jackson and the Olympians series attended the Season 3 premiere in outfits referencing Greek mythology. Andra Day wore a metallic bronze draped gown, while Dior Goodjohn opted for a corseted breastplate. The styling choices were intended to mirror the show's mythological world.

stories.title: Hunter Schafer wears archival Prada in London
stories.summary: Hunter Schafer attended a London photocall for Blade Runner 2099 wearing archival Prada. The choice was noted for its alignment with the sci-fi aesthetic of the series. The event took place at Regis House, with the city skyline serving as a backdrop for the promotional appearance.

stories.title: Speculation surrounds James Bond’s future wardrobe
stories.summary: Following the casting of Robert Pattinson as James Bond, industry observers are speculating on the future of the character's cinematic wardrobe. Tom Ford has provided suits for the franchise since 2008. There is now public discussion regarding whether the style will shift toward avant-garde menswear designs.

stories.title: Sotheby’s $39.8 Million Jewelry Sale Reveals What Collectors Value Most - Forbes
Ancient gold earrings show Greek fashion's endurance
stories.summary: Ancient gold earrings found in Black Sea burials suggest Greek jewelry designs remained popular well into the Roman period. Research published in Archaeology and Early History of Ukraine notes that first-century A.D. pieces share distinctive amphora-shaped pendants. Fashion has always been slow to move on.

stories.title: The 2,358-diamond necklace worn by Julianne Moore made its debut in Zagreb - Vogue Adria
7 jewelry pieces we spotted in Zagreb last night that have already made it onto our holiday wishlist - Vogue Adria
Prada expands its fine jewelry collection
stories.summary: Prada has expanded its Couleur Vivante fine jewelry collection for 2026. The latest release introduces new gemstone combinations and revised proportions for the house’s proprietary Prada Cut. The collection includes mini necklaces and stud earrings, alongside existing drop earrings now offered in more delicate sizes.

stories.title: Van Cleef & Arpels malachite and diamond set listed
stories.summary: A set of Van Cleef & Arpels malachite and diamond jewelry is currently on the market. The collection includes a necklace, bracelet, earrings, and ring, all inscribed with gold purity marks. The items are sold in their current condition, which is described as having minimal signs of wear.

stories.title: Sauer celebrates 85 years with high jewelry debut
stories.summary: Brazilian jewelry house Sauer marked its 85th anniversary with a cocktail reception in New York. The event featured the debut of a new high jewelry collection designed by creative director Stephanie Wenk and the launch of an Assouline book documenting the brand’s history.

stories.title: Spinel is no longer jewellery’s best-kept secret - Something About Rocks
The Timeless Allure of Sapphires: From the Star of India to 2026’s high jewellery creations - Prestige Online - Singapor
Movado Museum Classic watch marketed as wardrobe staple
stories.summary: Fashion director Anneliese Henderson identifies the Movado Museum Classic as a modern wardrobe essential. She cites the absence of numbers on the dial as a key feature that provides a clean aesthetic. The watch is currently being promoted for its ability to make outfits look polished.

stories.title: Shoulder bags remain a winter fashion staple
stories.summary: Designers are positioning shoulder bags as essential accessories for the upcoming winter season. Despite a general shift toward practical winter wear, the industry maintains that these bags serve as necessary additions to daily ensembles. They are marketed for use as commuter bags or date-night accessories.

stories.title: The Black Friday Watch Edit: 10 Everyday Watches Under £400 - ldnfashion
Travel jewelry cases marketed to prevent tangling
stories.summary: Retailers are promoting travel jewelry rolls and cases as essential items for preventing tangled chains during transit. The products range from Italian suede pouches to crossgrain leather rolls. The industry suggests these cases are necessary for those who wish to avoid unpicking knots upon arrival.

stories.title: Satin heels emerge as a fall footwear trend
stories.summary: Satin heels are being positioned as a formal alternative to leather and suede for the fall season. Celebrities including Jennifer Lopez and Amanda Seyfried have recently worn the pointed-toe style at public events. The fabric is being marketed for the softness it adds to formal ensembles.

stories.title: Diesel releases fall 2026 watch collection
stories.summary: Diesel has launched its Fall 2026 watch collection, targeting concert-goers and those attending music festivals. The brand describes the pieces as bold statement accessories intended to enhance personal style during live music events. The collection focuses on expressive designs for nights out.

stories.title: Jewelry-embellished flats marketed for party season
stories.summary: Fashion outlets are suggesting that flats featuring jewelry embellishments are the preferred party footwear for the current season. The trend draws inspiration from historical opulence and the aesthetic of 18th-century court fashion. Retailers are currently highlighting nine specific pairs for purchase.

stories.title: Why Peggy Gou’s watch collection is every collector’s dream - Prestige Online - Singapore
Meta glasses marketed as a fashion accessory
stories.summary: Meta is positioning its smart glasses as an elevated fashion accessory rather than just a functional device. The company offers over 50 combinations of frames, lenses, and case colors to appeal to the fashion crowd. The glasses feature adjustable components to ensure a seamless fit.

stories.title: Unspun bets on 3D weaving to eliminate overproduction
stories.summary: Unspun is promoting its OneWeave machine, which the company says creates garments straight from yarn to ensure nothing is left over. The firm aims to replace managed overproduction with on-demand manufacturing. From 1960 to 2018, clothing waste in landfills grew from 1.3 million to over 9 million tons.

stories.title: Unspun bets on 3D weaving to eliminate overproduction
stories.summary: Unspun is promoting its OneWeave machine, which the company says creates garments straight from yarn to ensure nothing is left over. The firm aims to replace managed overproduction with on-demand manufacturing. From 1960 to 2018, clothing waste in landfills grew from 1.3 million to over 9 million tons.

stories.title: Kashmiri textile traditions face encroaching mechanization
stories.summary: Kadri Mujtaba is working to preserve traditional Kashmiri weaving techniques, which he describes as the original work-from-home idea. Mujtaba has built a network of 2,000 artisans to maintain the use of hand-spun yarn and small wooden looms in the face of increasing industrial mechanization.

stories.title: India targets 350 billion dollar textile industry by 2030
stories.summary: Textiles Minister Giriraj Singh says India’s textile industry reached 190 billion dollars in 2025-26 and is poised to hit 350 billion dollars by 2030. The sector currently employs 5.3 million people, with 2 million additional jobs expected over the next three years.

stories.title: Ministry of Textiles to Celebrate 12th National Handloom Day on August 7 - DD News
AATCC offers testing material discounts for ITMA Asia
stories.summary: AATCC is offering a 5 percent discount on select textile testing materials through December 16, 2026. The promotion coincides with the company's attendance at the ITMA ASIA plus CITME 2026 trade show in Shanghai, where it will showcase standards and educational resources to the global textile community.

stories.title: Textiles ministry proposes 16,000 crore national fibre scheme
stories.summary: The Ministry of Textiles has proposed a 16,000 crore rupee outlay over five years for a National Fibre Scheme. The plan aims to strengthen domestic production of natural fibres and reduce import dependence. The proposal is currently awaiting government approval.

stories.title: Fabric accessories emerge as fashion growth drivers
stories.summary: Fabric accessories like scarves, headwear, and jute bags are increasingly viewed as strategic growth engines for the fashion industry. While apparel remains the primary revenue source, analysts note that accessories provide higher margins and engagement as digital retail expands the reach of these secondary product categories.

stories.title: ITMA Asia plus CITME 2026 opens in Shanghai
stories.summary: The 10th edition of ITMA ASIA plus CITME has opened in Shanghai, featuring over 1,950 exhibitors across 180,000 square metres. The event focuses on textile machinery, robotics, and resource-efficient processes, with new sectors dedicated to recycling, digital platforms, and automation.

stories.title: Sustainable runway event showcases recycled materials
stories.summary: Sustainable Coastlines Hawaiʻi hosted a fashion show featuring designs made from repurposed materials, including fishing nets, coffee shop receipts, and plant scraps. The event aimed to highlight the intersection of sustainability and fashion by reimagining how waste can be used in contemporary design.

stories.title: Here’s why thrifting and clothing swaps are so incredibly satisfying - The Washington Post
Repair marketplace Tingit partners with Vinted Go
stories.summary: Lithuania-based repair marketplace Tingit is expanding its visibility in France through a partnership with Vinted Go. The logistics arm of the sales platform is printing information about Tingit’s repair services on millions of shipping labels. The company claims price is rarely an excuse to discard imperfect items.

stories.title: Maxhosa Africa named Twyg Changemaker of the year
stories.summary: Maxhosa Africa received the 2026 Twyg Changemaker Award for its contributions to South Africa's fashion sector. The awards recognize designers based on criteria including material innovation, production transparency, and design quality. The ceremony was held on November 19 at Gorgeous George.

stories.title: Richmond project hosts weekly repair sessions
stories.summary: The Fixery, a volunteer-led project in Richmond, hosts weekend sessions for residents to repair clothing and household items. The initiative, which operates in partnership with the local council, also includes a scrap store and a cafe to encourage reuse over buying new products.

stories.title: Princess of Wales supports rice waste textile initiative
stories.summary: The Princess of Wales is championing SurpRice, a material developed in India from rice straw and husks. The project aims to provide a sustainable alternative to synthetic textiles while reducing agricultural burning. The material was created by a team including former British Fashion Council leadership.

stories.title: Black Star Fashion Week highlights sustainability in Ghana
stories.summary: The inaugural Black Star Fashion Week 2026 focused on the future of Ghana's fashion industry with an emphasis on sustainability. During the event, Northshore Apparel Ghana CEO Alhaji Nurideen Mohammed received an award for his work in inclusive industrialization and creating employment opportunities.

stories.title: Brands increase transparency to prove sustainability claims
stories.summary: As sustainability becomes a standard claim among fast-fashion retailers, brands are increasingly using product pages and social media to share specific details about supply chains and production processes. Companies are attempting to differentiate themselves by providing tangible evidence to support their environmental assertions.

stories.title: Bhumi Pednekar wears vintage silk at Earthshot Prize
stories.summary: Actress Bhumi Pednekar wore an outfit created from archival embroidered textiles and vintage silk sarees to the 2026 Earthshot Prize gala. The ensemble was designed by Bodements to celebrate traditional craftsmanship and textile reuse. The actress noted her preference for clothing that carries a sense of history.

stories.title: Nike Still Has One Big Question to Answer After Investor Day - The Business of Fashion
UK fashion group seeks export grants
stories.summary: The UK Fashion and Textile Association is urging the government to restore export grants, citing customs costs and tax hurdles. The group notes a 19 percent decline in clothing export volumes to the EU since 2023. It remains unclear how much paperwork constitutes a trade barrier.

stories.title: NCLT approves Everblue Apparel merger with Raymond
stories.summary: The Mumbai bench of the National Company Law Tribunal has approved the merger of Everblue Apparel with Raymond Ltd. The move aims to simplify the group structure and integrate garmenting operations into a single entity. The company expects the consolidation to facilitate better resource utilisation and operational efficiency.

stories.title: LVMH ends talks for Armani stake
stories.summary: LVMH has walked away from discussions regarding a stake in Giorgio Armani. L'Oréal and EssilorLuxottica remain in talks for minority holdings in the Italian house. The retreat follows reports of an 8 percent revenue decline at Louis Vuitton boutiques in France. Luxury is currently navigating a quiet period.

stories.title: Athleta appoints new brand leader
stories.summary: Gap Inc. has appointed Ashley Kechter to lead its Athleta brand. Kechter joins from Vuori, where she served as Global President, and previously held leadership roles at Fabletics. She began her career at Gap Inc. and now returns to oversee the brand's product strategy and operational performance.

stories.title: Ross Stores Plunges on Weaker Profit Outlook as Fuel Costs Rise - The Business of Fashion
Drapers editor calls for fashion retail support
stories.summary: Drapers editor Jill Geoghegan argues that fashion retail can help address the UK's NEET population if the industry receives government support. Proposals include lower employer National Insurance contributions for young workers and aligning minimum wage levels. The industry is currently waiting for a response to these suggestions.

stories.title: Mulberry reports narrowed operating losses
stories.summary: Mulberry cut its operating losses to £2.9m for the six months to 26 September, down from £5m a year prior. Revenue rose 18 percent to £63.7m. However, pre-tax losses widened to £33.4m due to a non-cash accounting charge linked to convertible loan notes. Accounting remains a creative pursuit.

stories.title: Warby Parker targets smart glasses growth
stories.summary: Warby Parker reports revenue of $245 million for its most recent quarter, a 10 percent increase. The eyewear company is now looking to smart glasses as a potential growth engine. It currently operates 360 stores while facing a sluggish market for new eyewear customers.

stories.title: Zara completes Fifth Avenue flagship renovation
stories.summary: Zara has finished a seven-month renovation of its 42,000-square-foot Fifth Avenue flagship in New York. The store features updated technology and interior design intended to evoke the city's architectural heritage. The retailer describes the site as unique within its global network of stores.

stories.title: On expands U.S. retail footprint
stories.summary: On is opening four new stores in the U.S. this quarter, bringing its total fleet to 23 locations. The expansion includes sites in Miami and Ardmore, Pennsylvania. The company says it uses industrial materials and local stone to celebrate the landscapes surrounding its new retail spaces.

stories.title: Kylie Jenner to open first Khy pop-up
stories.summary: Kylie Jenner is opening a physical pop-up for her brand, Khy, in West Hollywood this December. The digitally native label launched in 2023. Jenner stated that the space will allow customers to feel the quality and fit of the clothing, which is otherwise only visible online.

stories.title: Gucci offers Vision Pro runway access
stories.summary: Gucci has released an immersive video of its GucciCore fashion show for the Apple Vision Pro. The company says the production offers closer access than standard online videos. Users may find that the luxury experience is limited by the constraints of a digital headset.

stories.title: ThredUp launches on TikTok Shop
stories.summary: Resale marketplace ThredUp is expanding its livestream shopping efforts with a launch on TikTok Shop. The company previously reported success with livestreaming on the platform Whatnot. The move marks another attempt to sell used clothing through real-time video feeds.

stories.title: COMET opens first store in Pune
stories.summary: Indian sneaker brand COMET has opened its first exclusive store in Pune at The Pavillion Mall. The company says the move is part of its broader retail expansion plans across India. The mall confirmed the opening, which marks the brand's entry into the city's offline market.

stories.title: Underneat opens first physical store
stories.summary: Underneat has opened its first physical store in Gurugram, one year after launching as an online brand. The company plans to open 10 to 20 additional outlets next year. The store is designed as an experience centre where stylists assist customers with the brand's product range.

stories.title: Startup designs anti-tracking clothing
stories.summary: Leipzig-based Urban Privacy is developing clothing designed to hinder AI surveillance cameras. The jackets feature face-like patterns intended to confuse software and loose cuts to obscure gender identification. The company says the garments do not make wearers invisible, but they do make them harder to track.

stories.title: Warby Parker is betting its next chapter on smart glasses people actually want to wear | Fortune
stories.summary: Warby Parker is one of the clear winners of the 2010s-era direct-to-consumer (DTC) wave. It and other upstart digital-first brands like Allbirds shoes, Away luggage, and Casper mattresses used e-commerce savvy to cut out middlemen like wholesalers, upending their industries and selling straight to shoppers. While many of its peers

stories.title: JD Institute of Fashion Technology Honoured with ‘Best Placements in the Design Industry’ Award at National Icon Awards
Elle UK and British Fashion Council launch student competition
stories.summary: Elle UK and the British Fashion Council have launched the sixth edition of their Student Fabric Initiative. The competition provides surplus materials to university students to encourage circularity and creativity. Applicants are asked to submit work inspired by the concept of Made With Love. The materials are free.

stories.title: H&M awards 150,000 euros to design competition winner
stories.summary: Central Saint Martins graduate Macy Grimshaw has won the H&M Design Award 2026, the first iteration of the contest in six years. She receives 150,000 euros in funding and a mentorship. Her collection will be sold by H&M in fall 2027. The competition had eight finalists.

stories.title: SGA Foundation launches design program with Levi's
stories.summary: The SGA Foundation has launched Tunnel Vision, a program where students from Oklahoma State University and Toronto Metropolitan University design outfits for NBA player Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. Levi's is providing expertise and hands-on learning. The winning looks will be worn during the 2027 NBA season.

stories.title: Nigeria, Rwanda and Zimbabwe scoop top honours at African leather design awards - Daily Monitor
Queer Art announces inaugural design grant winners
stories.summary: Luiza Dale and Chong Gu are the recipients of the inaugural Queer Art Design Grant Awards. Each winner receives 10,000 dollars. The organization describes the prize as the highest cash grant currently awarded to LGBTQ designers working in architecture, graphics, landscape, fashion, and industrial design in the United States.

stories.title: Pitch To Get Rich Season 2 Premieres on December 4 - TechnoSports Media Group
Wilgot raises 3 million dollars for AI product discovery
stories.summary: Stockholm startup Wilgot has raised 3 million dollars in seed funding led by Industrifonden. The company makes brand products visible to AI assistants. The capital will be used to scale go to market efforts and accelerate development of its platform for AI powered product discovery.

stories.title: Amazon Global Selling targets 80 billion dollars in Indian exports
stories.summary: Amazon Global Selling has enabled 20 billion dollars in cumulative e-commerce exports from India since 2015. Head of Amazon Global Selling India, Srinidhi Kalvapudi, says the company aims to reach 80 billion dollars by 2030. The initiative focuses on helping Indian businesses build global brand recognition.
